summary: The trace shows a production planning task for automotive parts (Running Boards/Grill Guard) that shares the same core structure as the existing agricultural/harvest planning skill. The agent succeeded but had to iterate on column header alignment and initially made errors with the Grill Guard column structure. The key insight is that this 'automotive manufacturing' domain is essentially identical to agricultural harvest planning in structure (3 products, asymmetric constraints, minimum production requirements, temporary capacity boosts, early cutoffs) - it just uses different terminology (Crew Cab/Extended Cab/Grill Guard vs Wheat/Canola/Flax). Rather than create a new skill, I should update the existing production-planning skill to recognize automotive manufacturing as a variant of the same pattern, add explicit guidance about column header alignment for 3-product layouts, and document the specific constraint patterns seen here ( Grill Guard minimums, 10-hour shift boosts, Feb 1 cutoff dates).
